result.detail: Inputs are driven 1 ns after each rising edge, and outputs are sampled 1 ns after the edge. The model is updated in the testbench process using the same values the DUT sampled. Checks are counted separately for acc and sat. Only the first 20 mismatches are printed. The random phase uses a fixed seed (32'h1F2E3D4C) so it can be repeated; clear and reset are rare there so long runs can reach saturation. The directed phase reaches every corner on its own. Open risk: the nonce plusarg name (see claims). I can confirm it with the tech lead if the platform run shows a nonce mismatch.
